attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his essay, written in his own voice.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps his words 'fully changed his mind', the 'a few weeks later' timing and both 'after' clauses. Treating it as chronology rather than cause is reasonable.

contract.note: The essay's section is titled for the idea that LLMs would not get us to AGI, so reading the belief as whether LLMs are enough for human-level AI is the ordinary reading. Under that reading, a clear public rejection before November 2022 settles the claim.

evidence.note: In a June 2022 interview with MIT Technology Review, LeCun is quoted as rejecting outright the idea that scaling current LLMs will lead to human-level AI. This is months before the claimed reversal.
In a September 2022 ZDNET interview, LeCun calls LLMs such as GPT-3 'necessary but not sufficient' and says they miss essential pieces. This also predates November 2022.

reviews.rationale: Two independent 2022 interviews quote LeCun publicly rejecting scaled LLMs as a route to human-level AI in June and September 2022. That meets the contract's contradiction condition: he had already taken this position before the claimed post-November change. His tone may have sharpened later, but that is a different claim from changing his mind.

evidence.note: Dates Fukushima's neocognitron to 1980, an antecedent of CNNs. The packet has no LeCun date to compare it with.
McCarthy's 1959 paper treats common sense as a research goal, a long-standing predecessor.
Ha and Schmidhuber's 2018 world-models paper is prior work. Priority over LeCun's earliest world-model work is not shown.
Bender and Koller's 2020 critique of language-only training is a predecessor critique. LeCun's earliest LLM critique is not dated in the packet.

reviews.rationale: The evidence shows predecessors for CNNs, common sense, world models and the LLM critique. It has nothing on the critique of pure scaling, and it never compares these with LeCun's earliest relevant work, which the contract requires. The support condition needs all five ideas, and nothing meets the contradiction condition, so the claim is unresolved.

The support condition is not fully met and nothing contradicts the claim.
